title: Passive prompt injection: the inventory of every surface that feeds prompt text to an agent
objective: Measure and write down every surface through which text Intent stores or ships reaches an agent as prompt text, live or historical: where it lives, how an agent reads it, whether and by what route it can surface a stale copy, and what marks a non-live copy today. The report is the attachment `inventory.md`. It proposes no fix. The fixes moved to ST9f245bfe473ea7dd at the close-out of 2026-11-27.
context: Issue 0611 (hv, 2026-10-20) raised passive prompt injection: an agent that reads prompt-shaped text which is not live can act on it as an instruction. hv's ruling of 2026-10-23 (decision 70(5) on vc's board) opened this thread with the inventory as WP-01, and held every fix until hv reads it. The inventory is done (AC-01.1). At the close-out of 2026-11-27 this thread was pruned to the inventory and closed, and the fixes moved to ST9f245bfe473ea7dd, a future, unstarted thread.
